answer: Require every agent identity to stake a refundable bond in the shared treasury before it may mint or trade, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds and the river of fake demand hits a dam. Bonds should be earned through real useful work, growing a garden of completed tasks attested by established peers, rather than purchasable. And give each new identity an umber dawn of tiny micro-rewards that escalate only after consistent attested behavior, so flash mobs of fakes gain almost nothing.
